name: Cairn 120
tagline: A quiet downlight for exterior walls.
description: A folded rectangular hood conceals the optic from eye level. Mount it beside a door to place a soft pool of light at the threshold.
notes: Keep the drain slot at the bottom of the installed housing.

name: Fold 180
tagline: Two-way light with a concealed source.
description: A pair of recessed optics washes the wall above and below the housing. The shallow body fits narrow piers and entrance surrounds.
notes: Keep the drain slot at the bottom of the installed housing.

name: Vesper 240
tagline: A vertical sconce with a shielded aperture.
description: The deep housing directs light through a narrow vertical slot. A softly lit interior face gives exterior corridors a visible reference point.
notes: Keep the drain slot at the bottom of the installed housing.

name: Strata 420
tagline: Low, asymmetric light for pedestrian routes.
description: An offset aperture puts light onto the near side of the path. The rectangular shaft conceals the fasteners below a removable base cover.
accessories: QL-AB anchor kit | QL-TM setting jig
notes: Install with the light opening facing the path.

name: Reed 650
tagline: A slender marker with a radial glow.
description: The cylindrical head spreads light around the base of the fixture. Its narrow shaft suits paths that need frequent, unobtrusive markers.
accessories: QL-AB anchor kit | QL-TM setting jig
notes: Install with the light opening facing the path.

name: Mere 900
tagline: A taller bollard with a broad forward spread.
description: A broad, recessed lens lights the approach to shared entrances. A sloped cap sheds water and covers the removable optical cartridge.
accessories: QL-AB anchor kit | QL-TM setting jig
notes: Install with the light opening facing the path.

name: Fern 280
tagline: Shielded light for planting beds and paths.
description: A broad, shallow cap distributes light below the head. The short stem tucks between groundcover and the edge of a path.
notes: Place the remote driver in a suitable accessible enclosure.

name: Rush 350
tagline: An offset head for narrow planting strips.
description: A slim arm holds the optic just beyond the line of the stem. Rotate the head at installation to set the throw across the path.
notes: Place the remote driver in a suitable accessible enclosure.

name: Alder 500
tagline: A wide shade for low path illumination.
description: A pitched shade provides room for a wide, downward-facing diffuser. The taller stem raises the optic above low shrubs.
notes: Place the remote driver in a suitable accessible enclosure.

name: Sill 100
tagline: A recessed marker for stair risers.
description: A small horizontal aperture sends light down across a single tread. Recessed mounting keeps the trim close to the finished face.
accessories: QL-RH rough-in housing | QL-24 remote driver
notes: Set the rough-in housing flush with the finished wall.

name: Lintel 160
tagline: A wider wash for steps and low retaining walls.
description: A broad louver throws light across two adjoining treads. The narrow bezel leaves a clean edge against stone or poured concrete.
accessories: QL-RH rough-in housing | QL-24 remote driver
notes: Set the rough-in housing flush with the finished wall.

name: Flint 90
tagline: A compact spot for columns and small trees.
description: A narrow beam picks out a small surface from close range. The short yoke fits both a ground stake and a fixed mounting plate.
notes: Set the aim before tightening the yoke screws.

name: Beacon 120
tagline: An adjustable accent for textured facades.
description: A medium beam reveals texture without spreading far beyond the target. The deep barrel shades the lens when the fixture is tilted.
notes: Set the aim before tightening the yoke screws.

name: Gable 180
tagline: A wide wash for walls and low planting.
description: A broad rectangular optic spreads light across a nearby surface. The open bracket leaves room to adjust the angle after mounting.
notes: Set the aim before tightening the yoke screws.

name: Orbit 300
description: A wide circular head directs light down through a recessed diffuser. The short neck fits over a standard-size tenon.
notes: Verify pole and tenon suitability for the intended site.

name: Lantern 380
tagline: An open-frame head for pedestrian plazas.
description: A shallow top houses a downward-facing optic above an open frame. The broad spread suits area lighting on low poles.
notes: Verify pole and tenon suitability for the intended site.
